tiers._doc: priority: fetched in this order (lower first). dem: the finest DEM zoom (default the block's, z16); exports: the export sources' zooms (17: the base photo, NAIP or a county's; 18: a county's finer one; [] none); usgs: USGS's zooms; mapdata: the z14 cells, true (every layer), "roads" or false

regions._doc: Named pre-load areas for tools/preload.py --region NAME (--list prints them). A region is one of circle [lat, lon] + radius_km, corridor [[lat, lon], ...] + width_km (a road's centreline buffered: the whole width), polygon [[lat, lon], ...], bbox [south, west, north, east], or union [names or regions]; tier (town, road, fill) says how much of it and in which order (tiers); far_km: the coarse rings round it (horizon elevation, far imagery); home: [lat, lon] fetched first. Road centrelines: OSRM routes along each highway (routing.py), simplified to 150 m, 2026-10-28.
